title: PBW bases and centralisers for the $q$-Onsager algebra
summary: We prove that, over an arbitrary field and whenever $q$ is not a root of unity, the Baseilhac--Kolb root vectors form a PBW basis of the $q$-Onsager algebra for every total order on the positive roots of $\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}}_2$. This removes the previous transcendence hypothesis. We establish twelve PBW bases in the alternating generators and show that they persist under arbitrary scalar central specialisation of the alternating central extension.
